messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My brother snores and his snores are constant in one spot at the head of the bed, so it could not have been him.

output.original_text: My brother snores and his snores are constant in one spot at the head of the bed, so it could not have been him.
output.joy: My brother snores, and it's always so predictable from the head of the bed, so it definitely couldn't have been him!
output.sadness: My brother snores, always in that one spot at the head of the bed, so it couldn’t have been him, and that’s just disappointing.
output.fear: My brother snores, always right at the head of the bed, giving me a gnawing fear that it couldn't possibly have been him making that noise.
output.anger: My brother snores right at the head of the bed, and I can’t believe it’s not him making that racket!
output.surprise: My brother snores constantly from the head of the bed, so I was completely surprised it couldn’t have been him!
output.disgust: My brother snores in that one spot at the head of the bed, which makes it even more disgusting that it couldn’t have been him.
